description: This file contains tests for the BrowserContext's cookie clearing functionality in the Playwright testing framework, including various scenarios such as null cookies, isolated contexts, and filtering by name, regex, domain, and path.

methods.name: should clear cookies
methods.description: Test for clearing all cookies in a browser context.

methods.name: should isolate cookies when clearing
methods.description: Test to ensure cookies are isolated across multiple contexts and cleared independently.

methods.name: should remove cookies by name
methods.description: Test for removing specific cookies by name.

methods.name: should remove cookies by name regex
methods.description: Test for removing cookies matching a regex pattern.

methods.name: should remove cookies by domain
methods.description: Test for removing cookies associated with a specific domain.

methods.name: should remove cookies by path
methods.description: Test for removing cookies scoped to a specific path.

methods.name: should remove cookies by name and domain
methods.description: Test for removing cookies matching both name and domain criteria.
